1 Scientific Literature.Title: Application investigation of high-phosphorus steel slag in cementitious material and ordinary concrete
1 Scientific Literature.Authors: Fei Sha, Peng Liu, Yongling Ding
1 Scientific Literature.Journal_or_Source: Journal of Materials Research and Technology 2021;11:2074-2091
1 Scientific Literature.Study_Objective: Investigate retarding mechanism of high-phosphorus steel slag in Portland cement, its activation with CaO and Na2SO4, and its use with BFS and fly ash in ordinary concrete.
1 Scientific Literature.Abstract_or_Key_Finding: Soluble phosphate from depolymerising glassy phase retards setting. Optimum activators ~4% CaO and ~1% Na2SO4. Sole SS replacement recommended ≤15% for early strength and ≤35% for later strength; blended SS+BFS+FA 30-40% of binder with proportion 1:2:1 gave best concrete UCS.
1 Scientific Literature.Notes: Slag furnace type not stated ("high-phosphorus steel slag" from Shandong Iron and Steel, hot stuffy treated); intro discusses converter slag minerals.

2 Feedstock Chemistry.Source/Origin: Shandong Iron and Steel Company, China; hot stuffy (heat-stewed) processed
2 Feedstock Chemistry.Notes: Table 2. Meets first-grade steel slag powder GB/T 20491-2006. Analysis method not stated. Phases (XRD): C3S, C2S, RO, C2F, CF. P2O5 drops 8.1/23.2/25.4% after 3/6/12 h soaking (Fig. 5).

3 Processing.Equipment_or_Process: Hot stuffy (heat-stewed) technology at plant; ground to powder
3 Processing.Processing_Notes: Hot stuffy treatment for f-CaO digestion.
